bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears suffered a lopsided 31-7 loss to the rival Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field on Sunday, as the Bears gave up touchdowns on the Packers' first two possessions and were unable to overcome the early 14-0 deficit in the Week 5 defeat. With quarterback Caleb Williams still sidelined by a hamstring injury and an ugly Tyson Bagent game leading to an embarrassing loss , fans and analysts are now anxiously awaiting Williams' potential return for Week 6.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions bounced back in a big way on Sunday, routing the Arizona Cardinals 45-21 in Week 5, with Jared Goff throwing three touchdown passes and Jahmyr Gibbs adding 151 yards rushing and two more scores as the team scored on seven straight drives. The dominant win improved Detroit to 3-2 on the season heading into their Week 6 bye , easing concerns after a shaky start to the year.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers dominated their rivals with a 31-7 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday, a win that carried extra significance as the team moved back to .500 and delivered one of its most complete performances of the season . However, the celebration was tempered by news that tests confirmed Monday that Green Bay Packers defensive lineman Javon Hargrave tore his Achilles tendon during the victory, ending his 2026 season .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to a perfect 5-0 start by defeating the New Orleans Saints 23-13 on Sunday, with the Vikings' defense excellent against the Saints, leading the club to a 23-13 victory , while Kyler Murray turned in his best offensive performance of the season.
